Camden Settlement

A Philadelphia survivor settlement in Extremis Malis whose conflict with the Founders gives Caleb Dunne and Heather Ward their local lead.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-28

The local lead

Camden is the point where a community-level protection problem becomes evidence of the wider arms network. It is recorded as a source-specific settlement, not as real-world visitor or safety information. [1]

Claim ledger

  1. confirmed

    The graphic novel uses the Camden settlement as the community pressured by the Founders' armed demands in Philadelphia. [1]

  2. confirmed

    Heather Ward and Caleb Dunne use the settlement's conflict to trace the Founders' connection to Mantis's weapons operation. [1]
